ModMetaData.name: Geonosian Brain Worms
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
BRAINWORM_MOD_BUILD_1, built to design/RimStarWars/brain_worm_spec.md.
A Geonosian hive parasite. The worm itself is near harmless in the open; it is only dangerous as a payload. It burrows into a LIVING host and rides a staged infection -- latent, influenced, puppeted -- until the hive is driving the body. Cold kills it: below freezing the parasite dies and is expelled, so on a tidally locked world the cure is a PLACE. Surgery is the risky fast path.
Three infection vectors, all ruled by the owner 2026-09-11: 1. Geonosian ruin dungeons -- egg clusters in ancient-complex room loot. 2. Salvaged cargo -- the RSW_BrainWormCargoPod incident. 3. Weaponized-egg war retribution -- craftable mortar shells that burst into worms where they land. Carry a mortar to their map, shell them, leave.
RULING, PERMANENT (owner 2026-09-11, verbatim: "Never corpse-walker. Too gross."): this mod NEVER animates a corpse. Every puppeting path requires a living pawn -- CompRSWWormBurrow refuses a dead target, the puppeteer comp stops the moment the host dies, and the worm race sets canBecomeShambler false so Anomaly cannot make one out of it either. Do not add a dead-host path to this mod.
No Harmony: the puppet think tree rides vanilla's own Humanlike_PostMentalState insertTag hook, so there is no patch to collide with.
Private campaign mod, not for redistribution.
ART OWED: every texPath in this mod currently points at a vanilla stand-in (megascarab body, high-explosive shell). Nothing renders magenta, but nothing here is drawn yet either.
